bull.b: The sizeable contracted AI Cloud backlog provides multi-year revenue visibility and demonstrates customer demand for Bitdeer’s data center capacity. Long-term commitments can improve utilization, support financing, and diversify the business beyond volatile self-mining economics.

Record revenue and sharply higher adjusted EBITDA indicate improving operating scale and execution. If this momentum persists, stronger contribution from AI Cloud, hosting, and infrastructure services could improve operating leverage and gradually strengthen the earnings profile.

Lower power cost per Bitcoin and better fleet efficiency strengthen Bitdeer’s position in a power-intensive industry. More efficient hardware can support mining margins, improve resilience to protocol economics, and make the company’s infrastructure more competitive over the medium term.

bear.b: Deeply negative operating and free cash flow indicate that current operations and investment spending are consuming substantial liquidity. Continued cash burn raises funding needs, limits financial flexibility, and increases execution risk while the AI infrastructure portfolio is being developed.

Rapidly rising debt increases fixed financial obligations and reduces the company’s ability to absorb weaker mining economics or delayed AI deployments. Higher leverage also makes future funding more dependent on project execution, financing conditions, and sustained improvement in profitability.

Major AI and HPC projects still require substantial external financing, while management described credit conditions as tough. Delays or higher costs in securing funding could postpone capacity delivery, pressure liquidity, and reduce the pace at which contracted revenue converts into cash generation.
